title: Kenyan Flatbread with Spicy Oozing Topping
description: A unique Japanese-inspired appetizer featuring a spicy oozing sauce on top of crispy Kenyan flatbread.

ingredients.name: Spicy oozing sauce
ingredients.notes: Can be made with ingredients like sriracha, mayonnaise, and hot sauce

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.notes: For serving as a cooling contrast

instructions: Preheat a toaster or toaster oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cut the Kenyan flatbread into bite-sized pieces and toast until crispy.
Meanwhile, mix together the spicy oozing sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Once the flatbread is toasted, spoon the spicy oozing sauce over the top of each piece.
Garnish with a dollop of yogurt for a refreshing contrast.
